name: Shisui
description: Black-bladed katana that ignores a portion of incoming guard. Top-tier PvP pick for sword mains.

moves.name: Twin Crescent
moves.desc: Two arcing slashes that crit on the second hit.

name: Wando
description: Versatile straight blade with a strong neutral. Best entry-level legendary.

moves.name: Earth Splitter
moves.desc: Slam down to crack the ground.

name: Cursed Saber
obtain: Drop from Cursed Captain (Phantom Isle, 3rd Sea)
description: Drinks HP on hit. Trades raw damage for sustain in extended fights.

name: Iron Longsword
description: The first sword every sailor swings. Costs nothing. Worth nothing. Memories included.

name: Dual Katana
description: Two blades, one stance. Increases M1 attack speed by 20%.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.desc: Spin attack hitting all around you.

name: Sea Blade
obtain: Drop from Sea Beast (any sea, low chance)
description: Forged from kairoseki. Disables Devil Fruit defenses on contact.

moves.name: Tide Slash
moves.desc: A wave-like slash that strips fruit intangibility on hit.

moves.name: Drown
moves.desc: Curse target — they can't use C/V for 4s.

name: Yoru's Echo
description: An echo of the world's strongest blade. Slashes carry on the wind.

moves.name: Black Wave
moves.desc: Project an arcing dark slash that travels for blocks.

moves.name: Sky Slice
moves.desc: Vertical cleave that splits the horizon.

moves.name: World's Edge
moves.desc: Channel for 1s, release a city-block long slash.

name: Reinforced Tonfa
description: Not technically a sword, but it counts. Tonfa-style stance with parry.

moves.name: Parry
moves.desc: Block one melee hit and counter.
